paper_id: Guo et al. - 2022 - Saiyan Design and Implementation of a Low-power Demodulator for LoRa Backscatter Systems-1
title: Saiyan: Design and Implementation of a Low-power Demodulator for LoRa Backscatter Systems
motivation: Backscatter tags无法解调远程AP的反馈信号,因为LoRa解调需40mW而能量采集器每25.4秒仅产生1mW
problem_framing: 如何让backscatter tag以极低功耗解调LoRa下行信号,实现按需重传和信道跳频
key_insight: 利用SAW滤波器的陡峭频率响应,将调频Chirp变换为调幅信号,追踪峰值幅度即可解调
method_signature: SAW滤波器频幅变换+双阈值比较器+循环频移+相关器
evaluation_criteria: BER、吞吐率、解调距离(误码率<1‰时的最大距离)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Vanilla Saiyan解调距离仅55m,需手动配置阈值且留待未来加入AGC
evidence_for_taste: the envelope of a LoRa signal is a constant
using a high threshold alone fails to detect
using a low threshold alone causes false positives
theoretical minimum sampling rate exacerbates bit errors
the chirp signal will be transformed into an AM signal whose amplitude scales with the frequency
thinking_moves: 把FM信号解调问题reframe成AM信号峰值追踪问题
从工程异常(信号恒定包络)反推现有方案不可行
从物理器件(SAW滤波器)特性出发找新变换路径
先证RC电路不可行(寄生电容过小),再确立SAW方案
通过循环频移将目标信号隔离到中频带来避开包络检测的噪声污染
将功率密集型ADC替换为双阈值比较器,降低量化复杂度
